narration: “Katherine Holloway,” the child says, proud of the whole name. She keeps both hands around the candle’s little shelter of glass. “Nothing comes out. People put things in. Bad promises. Sometimes teeth.” At the gap, beneath the rush of warm air, you hear a scrape, then three deliberate knocks from below. A pause. Three more—the rhythm you played at the tannery door. Katherine’s eyes widen. “It never copied anyone before.” The two remaining pegs tremble but stay seated.

payload.what: After Mira's three-note motif was used above the grate, something beneath Low Sluice answered with the same three-beat rhythm.

ruling.understoodAction: Keep the access partly closed, identify the child, ask for history, and listen safely through the existing gap.
ruling.ruling: No check is needed to hear a deliberate nearby signal or receive Katherine's volunteered local knowledge. Two pegs remain because only one removal was established.
